en.scope: Mask support holds for every finite game with arbitrary b; nonzero conditions are explicit in normalization and linear reconstruction.

en.title: Shared proof: dividend support in an actual further-masked game
en.overview: If $S\subseteq T$, every $L\subseteq S$ used in the dividend satisfies $L\cap T=L$, so the dividend is unchanged. Otherwise choose $i\in S\setminus T$. Inserting $i$ changes no output of the further-masked game, and finite-difference dummy cancellation gives $I_{g_T}(S)=0$. Thus $I_{g_T}(S)=\mathbf1_{S\subseteq T}I_g(S)$, preserving any nonzero output baseline.
assumptions: Any finite raw game and fixed mask; normalization additionally needs nonzero reference dividends and linear ratio reconstruction needs nonzero used reference coefficients.

definitions.body_md: Fix the raw reference game $g$. The further-masked sample has game $g_T(L)=g(L\cap T)$, reference weight $U_S=I_g(S)$ and trigger $C_S(x_T)=I_{g_T}(S)/U_S$. The source AND of unmask indicators is $\mathbf1_{S\subseteq T}$.

en.proof_scope: Mask support holds for every finite game with arbitrary b; nonzero conditions are explicit in normalization and linear reconstruction.

proof_steps.title: First prove exact support of masked dividends
proof_steps.body_md: If $S\subseteq T$, every $L\subseteq S$ used in the dividend satisfies $L\cap T=L$, so the dividend is unchanged. Otherwise choose $i\in S\setminus T$. Inserting $i$ changes no output of the further-masked game, and finite-difference dummy cancellation gives $I_{g_T}(S)=0$. Thus $I_{g_T}(S)=\mathbf1_{S\subseteq T}I_g(S)$, preserving any nonzero output baseline.

proof_steps.title: Nonzero normalization equals the AND criterion
proof_steps.body_md: Divide the actual support identity by nonzero I_g(S) to get $I_{g_T}(S)/I_g(S)=\mathbf1_{S\subseteq T}$. The empty support retains actual b; if b=0 its normalized ratio lies outside the defined domain. This shared claim states the nonzero condition explicitly and does not resolve the source zero-coefficient definition.

proof_steps.title: Reconstruct linearly from actual current dividends
proof_steps.body_md: For current game h and fixed reference family U, each used nonzero U_S gives $U_S(I_h(S)/U_S)=I_h(S)$. Sum over subsets and apply Möbius reconstruction to obtain h(T). The current h need not equal reference g, and a fixed empirically sparse family is not guaranteed complete for every new input.

issues.title: 任意 DNN 的全局 Taylor 等式错误
issues.description_md: 原Lemma2.1未给解析、收敛与合法分组条件。
issues.evidence_md: 允许的ReLU网络 $v(t)=\max(t-1/2,0)$，参考0输入1：所有基线Taylor系数零而交互1/2。人读反例完整；Lean只验证有效有限多项式子结果。
issues.impact_md: 不修改原量词；有限多项式支持证明与原错误命题明确分开。

en.title: The global Taylor equality fails for arbitrary DNNs
en.description_md: Lemma 2.1 supplies no analyticity, convergence or legitimate-regrouping conditions.
en.evidence_md: The allowed ReLU network $v(t)=\max(t-1/2,0)$, baseline zero and input one, has zero Taylor coefficients but dividend 1/2. The human-readable counterexample is complete; Lean verifies the valid finite-polynomial component.
en.impact_md: The source quantifier is unchanged; finite-polynomial support proofs are separate from the false unrestricted claim.

issues.title: 奇次绝对触发的精确矩不等于有符号矩
issues.description_md: 原Theorem2.3的J定义为绝对幂，而印出的均值/方差公式使用有符号Gaussian幂；正文虽明确忽略低概率越界，精确未截断等式仍不成立。
issues.evidence_md: 一坐标$x=1,r=0,\tau=1,\pi=1,\epsilon\sim N(0,q)$，任意$q>0$：原J均值严格大于1，有符号均值1。PaperBayesian.general_moment_counterexample实际绑定原触发定义与Gaussian积分。平方相同还给真实方差小于q。
issues.impact_md: 该反例针对J，不否定真实最低交互的符号相消；Theorem2.4下界用独立乘积与绝对矩下界重新证明。

en.title: Exact odd absolute-trigger moments differ from signed moments
en.description_md: J in Theorem 2.3 is an absolute power, but the printed means/variances use signed Gaussian powers. The main text explicitly ignores rare crossings, while the exact untruncated equalities still fail.
en.evidence_md: For x=1,r=0,τ=1,π=1 and ε~N(0,q), every q>0 gives actual trigger mean strictly above one, whereas the signed mean is one. PaperBayesian.general_moment_counterexample binds the original trigger and Gaussian integrals. Equal pointwise squares also make the actual variance smaller than q.
en.impact_md: The counterexample concerns J and does not negate sign cancellation in the actual lowest dividend. Theorem 2.4’s bounds are repaired using independent products and absolute-moment lower bounds.

issues.title: 移动符号系数与固定参考幅值的记号作用域
issues.description_md: Lemma的U定义含当前x′符号，但最低项矩式与附录证明又把U及δ按参考x取固定系数；二者不能无说明混同。
issues.evidence_md: 真实最低多项式I=a∏(x_i′−r_i)可以跨符号区精确因式分解为U_ref∏(1+s_iε_i/τ)。这里U_ref=I(x)是固定基点值；U(x′)与J_abs(x′)配对才恢复同一I。
issues.impact_md: 提供忠实参考系数解释和完整实际交互证明；不将固定U×absJ反例误报成Theorem2.2真实I反例。

en.title: Notation scope of moving signs and fixed reference amplitudes
en.description_md: The Lemma defines U with current x′ signs, whereas lowest-term moments and appendix signs use fixed reference x. The two instances require explicit distinction.
en.evidence_md: The actual lowest polynomial I=a∏(x_i′−r_i) factors exactly across sign regions as U_ref∏(1+s_iε_i/τ), with fixed U_ref=I(x). Moving U(x′) must instead be paired with J_abs(x′) to recover that same dividend.
en.impact_md: Provide the faithful reference-coefficient interpretation and a complete actual-dividend proof; a fixed-U times abs-J example is not reported as a counterexample to the actual I in Theorem 2.2.

issues.title: 零参考交互使触发比值无定义
issues.description_md: 作者没有排除精确为零的参考交互，定义及二值约去都会使用该分母。
issues.evidence_md: 允许的常数网络v=1所有非空I=0，原归一化分子也0，得到通常实数中无定义的0/0。实际有限掩码支持律仍成立，但不能除以0。
issues.impact_md: 保留源定义域缺口；非零域的真实掩码声明只记有效适配，不覆盖原所有零系数。

en.title: Zero reference dividends leave trigger ratios undefined
en.description_md: The author does not exclude exact zero reference dividends, which occur in both the definition and binary cancellation.
en.evidence_md: The allowed constant network v=1 has zero nonempty dividends and zero numerator, producing undefined ordinary-real 0/0. Actual finite-mask support still holds, but division by zero is invalid.
en.impact_md: Retain the source domain gap; the actual mask theorem on nonzero reference coefficients does not cover every zero coefficient.

issues.title: 增长比的空支持与零噪声边界
issues.description_md: 严格包含本身不排空旧支持，原Gaussian参数也未在该条排零噪声；这些比值需要非零方差。
issues.evidence_md: S为空时J_S=1；σ=0时全部坐标扰动0、所有J恒1，所以相应方差为0。有效域S非空、σ>0时，Gaussian无原子与整数幂证明方差正，完整增长主干已实际形式化。
issues.impact_md: 不将边界无定义升级为有效正噪声比较被否定，不把Lean总除法0当作作者约定。

en.title: Empty-support and zero-noise boundaries of growth ratios
en.description_md: Strict inclusion does not exclude an empty old support, and this claim does not explicitly exclude zero noise. The ratios need nonzero variance.
en.evidence_md: If S is empty then J_S=1; if σ=0 every perturbation is zero and every J is constant one, giving zero variances. On the valid domain S nonempty and σ>0, Gaussian non-atomicity and integer powers prove positive variances, and the complete growth comparison is formalized.
en.impact_md: Undefined boundaries do not refute the valid positive-noise comparison, and Lean’s total division is not treated as an author convention.

issues.title: 特征方差与交互尺度比值的零域
issues.description_md: 原回归比例未排零特征方差，缩放界也未排零U导致的零交互方差。
issues.evidence_md: C1=C2=1,y*=1时独立常数特征损失(y*−U1−U2)^2有整条最优直线，而EC/VarC=1/0无定义。缩放若U=0，则I=0且VarI=0。
issues.impact_md: 真实期望损失的唯一全局最优已在正方差域证明；该条件不被隐藏为无条件原命题的机器证明。

en.title: Zero domains of feature-variance and dividend-scale ratios
en.description_md: The regression proportion does not exclude zero feature variance; the scaling bounds also allow zero U and therefore zero dividend variance.
en.evidence_md: Independent constant features C1=C2=1 with y*=1 have loss (y*−U1−U2)^2 and a line of minimizers, while EC/VarC=1/0 is undefined. For scaling, U=0 makes I=0 and VarI=0.
en.impact_md: The actual expected loss has a proved unique global optimum on the positive-variance domain; that condition is not hidden as a proof of an unrestricted source claim.

issues.title: 显著和缺激活条件且小残差未量化
issues.description_md: Eq5不同于Eq4，实际未写S⊆T，且“小”没有误差界；原式保留。
issues.evidence_md: 真实单变量线性掩码得分c>0，空输出0而显著单例交互和c，残差−c。PaperBayesian.salient_empty_mask绑定真实掩码得分和交互和，但只证明该精确代数事实，不冒充未量化近似命题的机器反例。
issues.impact_md: 正确残差需同时计遗漏激活项与纳入的未激活项；没有统一小尾界时不证明小残差。

en.title: The salient sum lacks activation and has no quantified small residual
en.description_md: Unlike Eq. (4), printed Eq. (5) lacks S⊆T and provides no bound defining “small”. The printed expression is retained.
en.evidence_md: For an actual one-variable linear mask score with c>0, empty output is zero, singleton salient sum c and residual −c. PaperBayesian.salient_empty_mask binds the mask score and dividend sum, proving that exact algebraic fact rather than a machine refutation of an unquantified approximation.
en.impact_md: The correct residual contains both omitted active terms and included inactive terms. No small-residual theorem follows without a uniform tail bound.

issues.title: 外引稀疏与对抗关系未给完整本地适配
issues.original_expression: \text{sparse emergence; elementary component of multi-order interaction}
issues.description_md: 外引技术前提不在本篇完整陈述；Appendix D代数分量关系不能自动转移所有对抗脆弱性结论。
issues.evidence_md: 有限重构可产生密集游戏；多阶上下文平均混合多种概念阶数。已证明的差分分解仅是准确有限代数适配。
issues.impact_md: 保留外引与经验角色；不将条件库引理算成整篇无前提原结论。

en.title: Cited sparsity and adversarial links lack complete local adaptations
en.description_md: The complete cited technical premises are not stated here. Appendix D’s algebraic component relation does not automatically transfer every adversarial-vulnerability conclusion.
en.evidence_md: Finite reconstruction can produce dense games, and fixed-size context averages mix several concept orders. The proved difference decomposition is an exact finite algebraic adaptation.
en.impact_md: Retain cited and empirical roles; a conditional library lemma is not counted as the whole unrestricted paper conclusion.

issues.title: 两端界下降不单独推出中间量阶数单调
issues.description_md: 源文保持approximately consider措辞；精确缩放界与后续近似推论是不同证明义务。
issues.evidence_md: Amin=.1,Amax=.2，KI为10、9，|U|分别.1、.2时，两端界下降但KC从1升至1.8。该逻辑例未声称完整BNN模型反例。
issues.impact_md: 整体阶数倾向还依赖近似模型、单项式到任意叠加的适配及经验数据。

en.title: Decreasing sandwich bounds do not alone force order monotonicity
en.description_md: The source says “approximately consider”; exact scaling bounds and the subsequent approximate inference are separate obligations.
en.evidence_md: With A_min=.1,A_max=.2, K_I values 10 and 9, and |U| values .1 and .2, both bounds decrease while K_C rises from 1 to 1.8. This logical example is not claimed as a counterexample to the full BNN model.
en.impact_md: The overall order tendency still depends on approximation, adaptation from monomials to general superpositions and empirical data.

issues.title: 掩码零坐标的零次幂不能判为零
issues.description_md: 原G1在未限制π_i>0时把所有掩码零坐标幂写成0。
issues.evidence_md: π_i=0时通常多项式约定0^0=1；正确筛选只删除支持包含某个未保留正次数变量的项。
issues.impact_md: 有限支持证明按严格正次数消去；不改原式，也不把该步骤修复当作任意DNN全局Taylor成立。

en.title: A masked zero coordinate to degree zero is not zero
en.description_md: G.1 writes every masked-zero coordinate power as zero without requiring π_i>0.
en.evidence_md: For π_i=0 the standard polynomial convention is 0^0=1. Correct filtering removes only terms whose support contains an omitted positive-degree coordinate.
en.impact_md: The finite support proof cancels only positive-degree factors. The printed step is retained, and repairing it does not establish unrestricted global Taylor convergence.

issues.title: 单项方差到整个交互缺少协方差控制
issues.description_md: 作者由单个绝对触发的支持增长及系数通常chaotic，粗略推出整个交互随阶数增长；没有系数概率律、交叉协方差或统一幅值前提。
issues.evidence_md: 有限L2和的真实方差包含 $\sum_{\pi,\rho}c_\pi c_\rho\operatorname{Cov}(J_\pi,J_\rho)$；同输入上的重叠次数触发不自动独立，移动符号系数也不能当固定数移出积分。
issues.impact_md: 保留原近似措辞及其完整论述；有效单项增长证明不升级为任意Taylor和的统一跨阶结论。

en.title: Whole-dividend variance lacks covariance control
en.description_md: The author roughly infers whole-dividend growth from single-trigger support growth and usually chaotic coefficients, without a coefficient law, covariance control or uniform amplitude condition.
en.evidence_md: A finite L2 sum has variance $\sum_{\pi,\rho}c_\pi c_\rho\operatorname{Cov}(J_\pi,J_\rho)$. Different-degree triggers at the same input need not be independent, and moving-sign coefficients cannot be treated as fixed scalars outside integrals.
en.impact_md: Retain the original approximation wording and complete argument. Valid single-trigger growth is not upgraded to a universal cross-order theorem for arbitrary Taylor sums.
